models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Very light, benign pattern over the Aeolians right now - 1-7 kt and flat water - but far too early to bank on it for the trip.
briefing.synopsis: Current consensus across the models shows a slack, low-gradient pattern over the islands: winds of roughly 1-7 kt swinging between a weak overnight S/SE land flow and a N to NE sea breeze by midday, with gusts mostly 5-14 kt. Seas are essentially flat - total wave 0.1-0.8 ft and swell 0.1-0.6 ft across Portorosa, Lipari, Panarea, Stromboli, Filicudi and Salina through 03 Oct. If this held, every leg would be a motor-or-drift affair rather than a weather problem. The payload gives no pressure-centre analysis, so I can't name the system driving it - only what the model wind and wave fields show.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: For the eve of departure, 03 Oct at Portorosa, the recommended berth is Portorosa Marina - an enclosed basin with all-round shelter, and the only listed option, so the choice does not matter. Forecast there is 3.5 kt SE, gusts 8.4 kt, swell 0.1 ft from the NNW, rated sheltered. Nothing in that picture would push the fleet to move; a change would have to come from a run shift between now and then.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Tomorrow is still two days before the fleet sails, so there is no departure window to call. For the first leg, Portorosa to Lipari on 04 Oct, the current guidance favours a 06:00 start with 5.3 kt SSE, gusts 11.7 kt and 0.1 ft seas - a 22 nm run on a dead run that will likely be under engine. Treat that time as provisional and re-brief on the morning runs.

passage_notes.note: Currently 'go' all day; 5.3 kt SSE at 06:00 easing to 1.8 kt E by midday, seas 0.1 ft. Light-air motoring more likely than sailing.
2-4 kt NW building slightly through the day, 0.1 ft seas; close to beam reach but almost certainly under power.
2-5 kt NW, beam reach, 0.1 ft. Berth at Marina del Gabbiano is rated only workable - open from every direction, no anchoring - so it depends entirely on it staying calm.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (06 Oct, 11 nm, 219°T)
passage_notes.note: 3-5 kt NNE, dead run, 0.1-0.3 ft. Short hop, no timing constraint in the current guidance.
4-5 kt E/ENE, run, 0.3 ft, at the very edge of the forecast horizon (reaches 07 Oct 23:00) - lowest-value numbers in the set.

cautions: Everything beyond about 48-72 h, which includes all the trip dates, is low-value guidance. Run-to-run direction shifts average 53° at 48-72 h and 64° at 72-120 h lead, so the wind directions quoted for 04-07 Oct should be treated as indicative only.
ICON-2i (2 km, 01 Oct 00Z) runs only ~60-72 h ahead, so the finest-grid model drops out entirely before the fleet sails; the later legs rest on ECMWF IFS and AIFS alone.
Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano is exposed through the full 360° with no anchoring option - the optional Stromboli night only works if the calm pattern verifies.
briefing.confidence_note: Confidence is moderate in the general character of the pattern - all models show light air and flat seas, and run-to-run wind-speed shifts have been small (0.7 kt mean at 48-120 h) - but low in any specific wind direction or hour for the trip dates, where mean direction shifts run 53-64 degrees.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
